evidence_snippets: The Kubernetes project recently discovered a new security vulnerability, CVE-2020-8554 , that might allow an attacker who has obtained permissions to create a Kubernetes Service of type LoadBalancer or ClusterIP to intercept network traffic originating from other Pods in the cluster.
